title: Jack Hanna's Into the Wild
description: Longtime zookeeper Jack Hanna hosts this Emmy-winning show that takes viewers on a journey around the world to showcase animals in their natural habitats. In addition to showing footage of the creatures and giving information about the places where they live, "Into the Wild" discusses the protection and conservation of endangered species. Among the locations visited are remote jungles, deserts, oceans and forests.

description: Pregame analysis, along with highlights from other college football games around the country.

title: College Football
description: Freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds and the Tigers (6-3, 4-2 ACC) host the Yellow Jackets (2-7, 1-5). Reynolds has rushed for 209 yards and two TDs in his last three games. Georgia Tech snapped a nine-game series slide with a 24-21 triumph in 2025.

title: College Football
description: The Texas State Bobcats (5-4, 3-2 Pac-12) host the Fresno State Bulldogs (5-4, 2-3 Pac-12) at UFCU Stadium in San Marcos. Fresno State relies on quarterback Jayden Mandal, while Texas State looks to quarterback Brad Jackson who enters with 19 TDs.

title: College Football
description: The New Mexico Lobos (8-1) host the UNLV Rebels (5-4) at University Stadium in Albuquerque for a Mountain West game. New Mexico is first in the conference after topping Nevada 31-3, while UNLV sits fifth following a 41-35 loss to Wyoming.

title: College Football
description: The Hawaii Rainbow Warriors (3-6, 2-4 Mountain West) host the North Dakota State Bison (7-2, 4-2 Mountain West) at Clarence T.C. Ching Athletics Complex. North Dakota looks to quarterback Nathan Hayes, while Hawaii looks to quarterback Micah Alejado.

title: TruCountry
description: "TruCountry" showcases some of America's top country artists, who perform in front of crowds at the Circle T Arena in Hamilton, Texas. The half-hour episodes feature down-home country music that represents the country's musical heritage and the genre's roots. Both veteran singers and young, up-and-coming artists perform their hits. Among the acts that have been featured on the show are Heather Myles, Leona Williams, James Hand, Jake Hooker and Darrell McCall.
